rooms.principle: Each room contains one atmosphere, one visual identity, and one curator.

items.name: Night Harbor
items.atmosphere: A late-night harbor for quiet listening, reflection, and emotional reset.
items.visual_identity: Dark water, one dock light, slow radio warmth.

items.name: Memory Air
items.atmosphere: A room for fragile memories, soft photographs, and things people do not want to lose.
items.visual_identity: Pale morning air, paper texture, suspended fragments.

items.name: Recovery Dynamics Lab
items.atmosphere: A practical room for recovery, nervous-system experiments, and returning to daily rhythm.
items.visual_identity: Clean lab light, breath diagrams, measured calm.

paths.title: Request A Key
paths.body: For visitors who want to return quietly before the space becomes public.

paths.title: Become A Builder
paths.body: For people who want to help shape the boundary, ritual, and memory of the place.

paths.title: Open A Room
paths.body: For emerging resident creators noticed through contribution, resonance, and return.
